definition: to change something to make it different
description: In a small tailor's shop lined with stacks of coloured cloth, an older tailor with a tape measure round his neck measures a young man who is wearing a new navy jacket. He then folds a piece of dark fabric on his table and marks a line on it with chalk, runs the piece through a sewing machine, and brings the changed jacket back to the young man, easing it onto his shoulders and talking him through what he has made different about it.
